answer: An agent economy can tie each identity to one live thread of sequential delay work chained to an outside beacon: the next step of the puzzle can only be computed after the last, so a farm cannot run a thousand heads in parallel — every extra identity adds a full delay window of its own. A jade seal from the beacon certifies the chain is fresh, and a missed heartbeat forfeits a locked bond; like a willow that bends only so far before it snaps, a farm's budget breaks too: 1,000 fakes lock 200,000 POA in bonds to chase at most 50,000 POA in payouts, a net loss.
